dict.string: OpenMargin uses the microphone to transcribe what you say. Audio is not saved.
OpenMargin transcribes the meeting on this Mac so it can enhance your notes.
OpenMargin listens to other people through your computer audio. It does not record the screen, save audio, or join the call.
